## Dieses Dokument

- Titel: Brief von Lotte Zweig an Hannah; Altmann, Manfred Altmann [17. Juni 1941], SZ-AAL/B1.138
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.138
- Datum: 17.6.1941
- Objekttyp: Brief
- Umfang: 3 Scans

pages.transcription:
I hear Hal an old friend of mine Guido Baron Fuchs
is in great need after Harry been interned for some months
he is also a great friend of Sir Frankenstein. Please send
him to Baron Fuchs in my name a few words to Manor Farm,
Upper Quinton,
Warwick

Hotel Wyndham                                Newyork, 17.6.41.

Dear Hanna & Manfred,

To-day was mail-day and we got a letter from
Korner but none of you, and as we had nothing from you last week
we were very much disappointed. Eva showed us a letter from you
when we visited her last Sunday, but ~~that~~ that is not the same.
- I hope that you are all well and that Manfred's exam is soon
over. Please inform us by cable of the result. And then go to
Bath and remain there, both of you. We feel that the house has
a certain justification of existing if you are in it, and it ought
to be nice now in summer. We do not yet quite know where to go,
but it will not be far from Newyork, probably, and we shall continue
to see Eva and have her with us for a while. To-morrow I shall see
her teacher, Miss Baker, who is passing through Newyork and will
come to see me. It is a pity Eva cannot be here, but her school
does not finish until next week, and right now they seem to have
examinations. I shall also discuss the school problem with Miss
Baker. - From us there is little to be told. We work, with lazy,
tired or excited periods in between, according to weather and news,
and besides that cocktail party we gave and where we had the whole
crowd here, we do not see many people just now. - I wrote you
that we had an answer from the Visa Department in Washington that
they do not more send cabled enquiries about the status of prospective
immigrants, so we must wait until your brother gets his reply in the
regular manner. Let us know at once if his affidavit is sufficient
or if not, which sum would be required as a deposit here. Maybe we
could get his sponsor to put up a deposit because this would mean
saving considerable time compared with trying to find an additional
affidavit etc.

As I hope to get a letter in a few days time,
I only send this as a preliminary note until I can reply to what
you write. With kindest regards to all,

Dear both, really there is not much to tell,             fondest love and kisses,
we live quietly and are ashamed that we have
food and leisure, while you are in foarba, we are
Lotte
furious when we see how much to {here} waste our spent; Lotte is much
better and the treatment has already clearly shown where the real source
of her ,alergic' cealhes are and we hope the best just because her reactions
to the injections have been sometimes rather violent. Now we have to look
where to go for the summer. It is not easy because houses in the country are
very expensive and as we have no car we should be near to a station and
all what ~~is~~ is near and has easy access is overcrowded especially in the week
end by millions of cars - no possibility for walks as Manfred loves them so
much. We hope to see Eva again next week, she feels happy as she really
merits it and I am glad that you feel now sure about her. Yours Stefan
pages.notes: Brief auf Hotelpapier, Typoskript mit handschriftlichen Ergänzungen am linken Rand und am Ende des Briefes (von Stefan Zweig). Die handschriftlichen Teile sind in violetter Tinte verfasst.
Rückseite des Dokuments, zeigt den durchscheinenden Text der Vorderseite (spiegelverkehrt).
Farbskala und Grauskala für Archivierungszwecke. Der Text der Vorderseite ist teilweise durch die Skalen verdeckt.

result.confidence_notes: Der Text ist sehr gut lesbar. Die handschriftlichen Ergänzungen von Stefan Zweig sind gut entzifferbar, auch wenn die Schrift etwas flüchtig ist.
